instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: PermitMile Credential Renewal brief: The objective is to review driver qualification renewals and prevent new trip assignments when qualifications are rejected or expired. Assigned Drivers submit renewal requests with current credential evidence. Credential Clerks check the evidence, record completeness, and record new validity end dates for accepted renewals. Safety Reviewers accept or reject requests and add rejection reasons. Fleet Schedulers assign drivers to future trips only while qualifications are active. Rejected and expired qualification records remain in history. Driver training and licensing-authority submissions are outside the project. The earliest submission time and required evidence set are not defined.

output.business_objective: Review driver qualification renewals and prevent new trip assignments when qualifications are rejected or expired.
